src-tauri/src/main.rs: Binary entry point: only calls margin_lib::run().
src-tauri/src/tray.rs: System tray menu: needs a running Tauri app and a desktop tray; no pure logic.
src-tauri/src/wayland_idle.rs: Wayland ext-idle-notify client: needs a live compositor connection; no pure logic.
src/lib/editor.ts: CodeMirror/DOM setup for the editor view: covered by e2e, not importable by node --test.
src/lib/transclude.ts: CodeMirror widget/fetcher for #+TRANSCLUDE:: DOM and Tauri invoke, covered by e2e; the directive parsing is unit-tested but lives in the same module.
